arStrings.szText: This Mega Bundle contains the "Lily" pet, "In Mother's Name" mount armor, "Mother's Warmth" Barbarian armor, "Mother's Embrace" Druid armor, "Mother's Kiss" Necromancer armor, "Mother's Whisper" Rogue armor, "Mother's Mercy" Sorcerer armor, and "Mother's Memory" Spiritborn equipment.
